subcategory_text: Manually review code that static analysis cannot effectively evaluate (e.g., authentication logic, access-control checks, cryptographic usage, complex business rules).
implementation_examples: Define a list of high-risk code areas that require manual review
Assign security-knowledgeable reviewers for these areas
Document the manual review outcome in the change record
assessment_objectives: Determine whether manual review is performed on high-risk code areas.
Determine whether manual review outcomes are documented.
